subject.title: fix(ai): provider-billed totals desync the cost breakdown and drop cache writes

question: Should OpenClaw make `Usage.cost.estimatedTotal` a supported stable plugin-SDK and transcript contract for distinguishing a provider-billed total from its catalog estimate?
rationale: The cache-write and overflow fixes repair existing behavior, but the new retained-cost property is exported through the plugin SDK and creates a durable API/data contract beyond the narrow bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor the additive cost-provenance field
options.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as a stable optional `Usage.cost` field and merge the complete accounting and transcript propagation path.

options.title: Constrain the change to existing contracts
options.body: Keep the cache-write and overflow repairs but redesign or defer the retained-estimate behavior until a separately approved public cost API is defined.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the additive cost-provenance field
recommendation.body: Accept `estimatedTotal` as a stable optional `Usage.cost` field and merge the complete accounting and transcript propagation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The public LLM-core `Usage` type and its plugin-SDK exposure trace through the LLM-core extraction authored by this contributor.
